name: giuseppe-trisciuoglio-pi-prevent-destructive-commands
description: A pi extension that proactively blocks destructive Bash commands, protecting projects from accidental deletions, irreversible Git operations, and dangerous Docker or AWS actions. It also analyzes nested commands, wrappers, pipelines, and shell invocations, providing configurable protection in every usage mode.
